source_note: Canonical requirement register. Markdown and Excel are projections of these rows.

requirements.title: Delivery exception queue
requirements.evidence_status: Live events and intervention log required
requirements.given: ETA is within the agreed threshold and delivery is unconfirmed
requirements.then: one active case appears with order_id, owner, due date, threshold version and flag time

requirements.title: Delivery experience comparison
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: eligible delivered orders with and without reviews
requirements.when: the period and state are selected
requirements.then: late and on-time counts, reviewed counts and mean order-level scores use the same delivery cohort

requirements.title: State delivery prioritization
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: states have differing rate and volume
requirements.then: both late count and late rate appear with denominator, threshold and missing-date coverage

requirements.title: Delivery trend
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: the prior calendar month has no eligible deliveries
requirements.then: the missing comparator is displayed as unavailable and sparse periods are flagged

requirements.title: Seller exposure scorecard
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: a seller has multiple items on one eligible order
requirements.then: that seller-order counts once and the late count cannot exceed the eligible delivered count

requirements.title: Seller comparison guardrails
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: a seller has fewer than 30 eligible delivered orders
requirements.then: the rate retains its denominator and is marked insufficient sample, with no punitive recommendation

requirements.title: New seller quality gate
requirements.given: a seller reaches an agreed observation threshold
requirements.then: a human reviews evidence and records the decision and dispute path

requirements.title: Customer multi-order baseline
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: one customer_unique_id appears on two customer_id values
requirements.then: the person counts once in the denominator and once in the multi-order numerator

requirements.title: Customer recovery workflow
requirements.evidence_status: Consent, service history and budget required
requirements.given: a confirmed late order meets an approved recovery policy
requirements.then: the action, consent, cost and outcome are recorded and duplicate contacts are prevented

requirements.title: Review theme analysis
requirements.evidence_status: Labeled review sample and validation required
requirements.given: a manually labeled Portuguese review sample exists
requirements.then: precision and recall by theme and uncertain predictions are reported before production use

requirements.title: Customer cohort follow-up
requirements.evidence_status: SQL cohort output accepted; native cohort page outside five-page scope
requirements.given: a cohort lacks a full observation window
requirements.then: unobserved periods remain unavailable and observed zero-return periods display zero

requirements.title: Category merchandise and freight
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: more than one category is selected
requirements.then: total freight is divided by total merchandise plus freight for the same selected items

requirements.title: Freight exposure alert
requirements.given: a category exceeds an agreed ratio and monetary materiality threshold
requirements.then: one investigation is created with supporting amounts, volume and policy version

requirements.title: Monthly merchandise baseline
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.then: the result reconciles to the all-item control total and identifies incomplete edge months

requirements.title: Metric governance
requirements.evidence_status: Historical SQL + native DAX UAT passed; operational acceptance separate
requirements.given: a KPI definition or source version changes
requirements.then: SQL, evidence, DAX, visual, README and memo identify the same definition and population
